worker_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections each worker process can handle.

keepalive_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) to keep connections open for reuse by clients.

types_hash_max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of the hash tables used for MIME types.

gzip_types.description: List of MIME types to compress with Gzip.

gzip_comp_level.description: Gzip compression level (1–9). Higher values give better compression but use more CPU.

ssl_protocols.description: Allowed TLS protocol versions. Avoid insecure protocols like SSLv3, TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1.

ssl_ciphers.description: Strong cipher suites allowed for TLS connections (colon-separated for readability, but must be quoted in config).

ssl_session_cache_size.description: Size of the shared SSL session cache. Accepts suffixes like 'k', 'm', or 'g'.

ssl_session_timeout.description: Time (in minutes) SSL session parameters are cached.
